public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        final long MOD = 1000000007L;
        long answer_value = 0;

        if (k == 0) {
            answer_value = computePower(p, p - 1, MOD);

            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                if ((p - 1) % i == 0 && computePower(k, i, p) == 1) {

                    }

        }
        System.out.println(answer_value);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long computePower(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
